pergunta: What did Nate do while Joanna was on her road trip?

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 7:37 pm on 15 April, 2022
[D7:5] Nate: Thanks Jo! I picked this color because it's bright and bold - like me! I wanted to stand out from the regular options.
[D7:6] Joanna: That's amazing, Nate! Your boldness really inspired me. It reminded me of this gorgeous sunset I saw while hiking the other day. It made me realize the importance of showing the world who we are.
[D7:7] Nate: Wow, that sunset looks awesome! Jealous! I bet you had a great time. Are there any more exciting trips coming up for you?
[...]
[D7:13] Nate: Take care!
Session date: 6:44 pm on 17 April, 2022
[D8:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! Haven't talked with you in a while - how's it going?
[D8:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Great to hear from you. I've been reading a lot in the past week! There's a lot of good books I forgot I owned.
[...]
[D8:21] Nate: Hey Joanna, glad I could help. Let me know how it turns out!
[D8:22] Joanna: Got it, Nate. I'll definitely let you know how it turns out. Thanks for sharing the recipe!
Session date: 7:44 pm on 21 April, 2022
[D9:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Long time no talk! I wanted to tell ya I just joined a writers group. It's unbelievable--such inspirational people who really get my writing. I'm feeling so motivated and supported, it's like I finally belong somewhere!
[D9:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! That's awesome! Having a supportive group around you can really make a difference. What kind of projects are you working on with them?
[D9:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! We've made some great progress. I'm working on one with my group called "Finding Home." It's a script about a girl on a journey to find her true home. I find it really rewarding and emotional. What about you? Any upcoming gaming tournaments?
[D9:4] Nate: Hi Joanna! "Finding Home" sounds really special. Must be so meaningful to work on. I've got a gaming tournament next month and I'm feeling good about it. It's gonna be my 4th one!

Session date: 2:01 pm on 23 January, 2022
[D2:2] Nate: Hi Joanna! Long time no see! What's been going on? You sound excited!
[D2:3] Joanna: Woo! I finally finished my first full screenplay and printed it last Friday. I've been working on for a while, such a relief to have it all done!
[D2:4] Nate: Wow, that sounds awesome! What's it about? Glad it's all down!
[...]
[D2:26] Nate: That's great to hear! Those are both great things. I'm glad to hear you've got other things to help you get through times of axiousness despite not being able to have animals!
[D2:27] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Writing helps me create wild worlds with awesome characters. Plus, it's a great way to express my feelings. I can't imagine life without it.
[D2:28] Nate: Wow, Joanna, that sounds amazing! Keep doing what you love!
[D2:29] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I'll definitely keep pursuing my passion for writing. It means a lot.
Session date: 9:27 am on 7 February, 2022
[D3:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! The screenplay I sent in to the film festival has been on my mind all day everyday. I keep bouncing between crazy emotions like relief, excitement and worry! Fingers crossed a producer or director falls in love with it and it ends up on the big screen - that would be awesome!
[D3:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! It is a big deal! I'm sure its been a wild ride. Sending some positive vibes and hoping someone likes it enough to get it on the big screen - that would be awesome!
[D3:3] Joanna: Thanks Nate, your support really means a lot. I put a lot of effort into it and I'm crossing my fingers. What about you? Anything new and exciting happening in your life?
[D3:4] Nate: Thanks, Joanna. Not much has changed for me, but I just discovered that I can make coconut milk icecream and gave it a try. It was actually pretty good, so I'm proud of myself.
[D3:5] Joanna: Looks delish! Glad you tried something new and it went well. What did you think of it?

Session date: 8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022

[D25:25] Nate: Yeah, they each do. One is more adventurous while the other is more reserved, which I find cute. Having them around brings me joy and they make great companions.
[D25:26] Joanna: That's super cool! I never knew turtles could be so interesting until I met your turtles. Wow!

[D26:21] Joanna: Awesome! I'll bring some of my recipes so we can both share deserts!
[D26:22] Nate: I'd love that! I've been wanting to try some of your chocolate and rasberry cake for a while now.
[D26:23] Joanna: You got it! See you tomorrow!

Session date: 8:10 pm on 7 November, 2022
[D27:4] Joanna: Sounds like you're really loving life right now! It's great when you find something that suits you. Being busy can be tiring but it's so rewarding in the end. Keep it up!
[D27:5] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! I'm really grateful to have a job I enjoy every day. So anyways, anything new going on in your life?
[D27:6] Joanna: I am writing another movie script! It's a love story with lots of challenges. I've put lots of hard work into it and I'm hoping to get it on the big screen.
[D27:7] Nate: Woah Joanna, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?
[D27:8] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!
[D27:9] Nate: Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Joanna? What brings you happiness?
[D27:10] Joanna: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.

Session date: 2:01 pm on 21 October, 2022
[D24:3] Nate: Hey Joanna! That's cool. I've been getting so stressed lately because of my tournament progress - tough competitors - but my turtles always cheer me up.
[D24:4] Joanna: Pets have a way of brightening our days. I still have that stuffed animal dog you gave me! I named her Tilly, and she's always with me while I write.
[D24:5] Nate: Glad to hear it! What made you name her Tilly?
[...]
Session date: 8:16 pm on 25 October, 2022
[D25:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Another movie script that I contributed to was shown on the big screen last Sunday for the first time! It was such a surreal experience to see everything come together. I felt a mix of emotions, but overall, it was a satisfying moment. I've been waiting for this for a long time!
[D25:3] Nate: Congrats Joanna! How was it to finally see it on the big screen?
[D25:4] Joanna: It was an amazing experience! I'll never forget seeing all of the characters and dialogue I wrote being acted out - it was such a cool feeling. Having all the hard work and determination I put into writing pay off was definitely rewarding. I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!
[...]
[D25:6] Joanna: Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.
[D25:7] Nate: Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?
[D25:8] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.
[D25:9] Nate: That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?
[D25:10] Joanna: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.
[D25:11] Nate: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?
[D25:12] Joanna: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!

Session date: 12:06 am on 11 November, 2022
[D29:1] Joanna: Nate, can you believe it? I'm finally filming my own movie from the road-trip script!
[D29:2] Nate: Congrats, Joanna! Not surprised at all that your hard work paid off. Must feel awesome to see your script come alive in a movie! Pretty cool when something you love brings success, right? Tell me more about your movie!
[...]
[D29:10] Nate: Yeah, turtles are like zen masters! They always remind me to slow down and appreciate the small things in life. I'm loving experimenting with flavors right now. Here are some colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream that I made.
[D29:11] Joanna: Hey Nate, that looks really yummy! The colors and mix-ins give it a nice kick.
[D29:12] Nate: Nice! I'm glad you like it too. This recipe really jazzes it up. Wanna give it a try?
[D29:13] Joanna: Definitely, Nate! That ice cream looks mouthwatering. Thanks so much for offering!
[D29:14] Nate: No worries, Joanna. Hope you enjoy it!
[D29:15] Joanna: Yea, no worries! It was great catching up. Take it easy!
